vision: Create a unified machine learning feature store that centralizes feature engineering, ensures consistency between training and inference, and accelerates ML model delivery while reducing redundant computation and operational costs.
scope: The epic covers the design and MVP implementation of a centralized feature store using Feast, Databricks, and Redis. It includes feature registration, versioning, batch and real-time computation, point-in-time joins, monitoring, and secure access control. Out of scope: model training pipelines, external data ingestion, and automated retraining orchestration.
success_criteria: Real-time feature serving latency < 10ms for 50 features (p99)
Eliminate >50% code duplication in feature pipelines
Support 500 concurrent model serving requests without degradation

user_stories.title: Implement feature registry with versioning and metadata in Feast
user_stories.i_want: to register, version, and manage features with lineage and metadata
user_stories.so_that: ML models can access consistent features and trace them back to their data sources

acceptance_criteria.when: I register them via the Feast API
acceptance_criteria.then: the registry stores metadata, version, owner, and lineage details

user_stories.title: Enable batch feature computation on Databricks with scheduled Spark jobs
user_stories.i_want: to compute batch features daily and hourly using Spark on Databricks
user_stories.so_that: training datasets remain up-to-date and consistent across models

acceptance_criteria.then: features are updated in Delta tables without duplication

user_stories.title: Develop real-time feature serving layer using Redis integrated with Feast
user_stories.i_want: to serve online features with latency under 10ms (p99)
user_stories.so_that: inference pipelines can consume consistent, low-latency features

acceptance_criteria.then: feature values are returned within <10ms latency

user_stories.title: Implement point-in-time correct joins for feature extraction during training
user_stories.i_want: to retrieve training data with accurate historical feature values
user_stories.so_that: model training avoids data leakage and represents true historical context

acceptance_criteria.given: a training dataset with event timestamps
acceptance_criteria.then: only features available at the time of each event are included

user_stories.title: Establish feature monitoring and drift detection across offline and online stores
user_stories.i_want: to detect feature drift between training and inference
user_stories.so_that: we can maintain model performance and data reliability over time

acceptance_criteria.then: an alert is triggered with affected feature details

user_stories.title: Implement team-based access control using Unity Catalog integration
user_stories.i_want: to manage feature access permissions by team
user_stories.so_that: data scientists and engineers can securely share and manage features

acceptance_criteria.when: I assign permissions in Unity Catalog
acceptance_criteria.then: access controls are enforced for feature creation and retrieval

user_stories.title: Provide Python SDK and REST API for feature retrieval and management
user_stories.i_want: to easily fetch, register, and monitor features via SDK or REST interface
user_stories.so_that: feature store integration becomes seamless within ML workflows

acceptance_criteria.when: I invoke SDK methods or API endpoints
acceptance_criteria.then: features are fetched or updated according to access rights
